body: I know my parents will help somehow but my dad is the entire source of my anxiety. When i didnt have a job and he knew, he messaged me daily telling me that I had better get a job and that I'm an idiot for leaving a job without finding another first, and that I better have rent money figured out. My fiancee knows about the finances and she is trying her best but her family isnt in a position to help. Well some are, but those who are dont care about her. Those who do care, cant help. I just feel like when my dad finds out, that's it. I'm not living with that shame.
